title.en: And Quiet Flows the Don: reviewed English and five complete editions
title.zh: 《静静的顿河》：核修英文，新增五语全文
title.zh-hant: 《靜靜的頓河》：核修英文，新增五語全文

summary.en: Five essays on Grigori, love, family and civil war. Reviewed English retains its independent form with supporting narrative restored; five complete new editions follow the corrected Chinese essays.
summary.zh: 5 篇核对原著事实，保留英文独立散文并补足关键叙事，新增日、法、德、西、韩全文；保留对人物、关系与战争的阅读。
summary.zh-hant: 5 篇核對原著事實，保留英文獨立散文並補足關鍵敘事，新增日、法、德、西、韓全文；保留對人物、關係與戰爭的閱讀。
